verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Weaviate's filter operators. It has nothing on range comparisons, geo filters, nested AND/OR logic or array-membership conditions. The only nearby mention is 'keyword filtering' combined with vector search (weaviate-gh-4), which describes keyword/BM25 retrieval rather than structured metadata filter expressions, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries
